purpose: Exemplar for the typed-extraction path — caller passed a `specified_finding_format` schema, so signals should ALSO carry a validated payload alongside the generic finding_summary/finding_category.

input.question: Which meetings mentioned a specific dollar figure? Extract the amount and the surrounding context.

amount_usd.description: The dollar amount mentioned. Use the number only — no currency symbol.

context_summary.description: One-sentence description of what the dollar amount refers to (deal size, discount, uplift, ARR, etc.)

expected_orchestrator_behavior.step_1_filter: Broad inclusion — dollar figures could surface in any meeting type. No hard filter to enforce.
expected_orchestrator_behavior.step_4_signals: One signal per distinct dollar figure. finding_summary describes the figure in plain English; payload carries the strongly-typed extraction. Sub-agent must NOT include a payload field when specified_finding_format is null (default flow) — only when it's populated.
expected_orchestrator_behavior.payload_validation: Every emitted signal's payload must validate against the schema OR the signal is dropped as accuracy_pass=false.

exemplar_signals.finding_summary: Nimbus Health's CFO cited $490K in annual contract value with roughly half unused.

payload.context_summary: Nimbus Health annual contract value under discussion; half unused per CFO.

exemplar_signals.reference_text_shape: A verbatim quote where the CFO cites the $490K figure.

exemplar_signals.finding_summary: Meridian Retail was quoted 15% ACV or a $50K minimum for the Spanish language module.

payload.context_summary: Spanish language module pricing floor quoted to Meridian Retail.

exemplar_signals.reference_text_shape: A verbatim quote naming the 15% / $50K floor for the Spanish module.

exemplar_response_text:
Two meetings surfaced specific dollar figures:

- **Nimbus Health**, May 2026 [s1] — $490K in annual contract value (roughly half unused).
- **Meridian Retail**, June 2026 [s2] — a $50K minimum quoted for the Spanish language module.
anti_patterns_this_run_should_avoid: Emitting a payload field when the caller didn't request extraction (default flow).
Populating payload.amount_usd with a value not present verbatim in the reference_text.
Confusing the two roles: finding_summary is prose; payload is the machine-typed extraction. Both must agree on the underlying facts.
